changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_action DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind CHECK (kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','DELIVER_FEEDBACK','EDIT_FEEDBACK', 'RETRACT_FEEDBACK','SLACK_POST','PUBLISH_REPORT','CLEANUP_ISSUE','TRANSFER_ISSUE','DRAFT_REPORT')), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_workspace, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_workspace CHECK (workspace_id IS NOT NULL OR kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','PUBLISH_REPORT','CLEANUP_ISSUE','TRANSFER_ISSUE','DRAFT_REPORT')); ALTER TABLE llm_usage_event ALTER COLUMN workspace_id DROP NOT NULL, ADD COLUMN action_id uuid, ADD COLUMN settle_after timestamp(6) with time zone, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_open_call, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_open_call CHECK (call_state <> 'OPEN' OR ((source_type = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND action_id IS NOT NULL AND settle_after IS NOT NULL) OR (run_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_epoch IS NOT NULL))), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_scope CHECK ( (source_type = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND workspace_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL AND lease_epoch IS NULL AND funding_source = 'INSTANCE' AND model_kind = 'CHAT' AND practice_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL) OR (source_type <> 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND workspace_id IS NOT NULL)), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source_type, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source_type CHECK (source_type IN ('REVIEW_JOB', 'MENTOR_TURN', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_DECISION', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_EMBEDDING', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_RERANKING', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT')); -- A report that waited for a worker's draft when the instance stopped has no draft action. -- It routes without a draft, as a report that no worker drafted within ten minutes did. UPDATE product_feedback_filing SET state = 'ANSWERED', answer = NULL, drafted_at = NULL, next_attempt_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE state IN ('DRAFT_QUEUED', 'DRAFTING'); ALTER TABLE product_feedback_filing ADD COLUMN draft_admitted_at timestamp(6) with time zone, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_product_feedback_filing_state, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_product_feedback_filing_state CHECK (state IN ('DRAFT_QUEUED', 'DRAFTING', 'DRAFT_WAITING', 'ANSWERED', 'HELD', 'QUEUED', 'FILING', 'FILED', 'SAVED', 'STOPPED')), DROP COLUMN claimed_by, DROP COLUMN lease_until, DROP COLUMN failures; -- Accounting survives report erasure, including an open call that completes afterwards. CREATE INDEX idx_llm_usage_action ON llm_usage_event(action_id); CREATE FUNCTION detach_product_feedback_draft_usage() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE llm_usage_event SET source_id = gen_random_uuid(), call_state = CASE WHEN call_state='OPEN' THEN 'SETTLED' ELSE call_state END, measurement_verification = CASE WHEN call_state='OPEN' THEN 'UNVERIFIABLE' ELSE measurement_verification END, pricing_state = CASE WHEN call_state='OPEN' THEN 'UNPRICED' ELSE pricing_state END, cost_usd = CASE WHEN call_state='OPEN' THEN NULL ELSE cost_usd END, unreported_calls = CASE WHEN call_state='OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE unreported_calls END WHERE source_type = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND workspace_id IS NULL AND source_id = OLD.id; RETURN OLD; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER product_feedback_detaches_draft_usage AFTER DELETE ON product_feedback FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION detach_product_feedback_draft_usage();
